title: Ayush Shetty Upsets Srikanth at French Open; Lakshya Sen Withdraws
indian_angle: This report highlights a significant victory for young Indian talent Ayush Shetty over former World No. 1 Kidambi Srikanth, alongside Lakshya Sen's withdrawal from the French Open.
summary: Ayush Shetty advanced at the French Open 2026 by defeating fellow Indian Kidambi Srikanth in a three-game encounter. Meanwhile, Lakshya Sen gave a walkover to Japan's Kodai Naraoka, ending his tournament run.

title: Junior Selection Committee Meeting Minutes Released by BAI
indian_angle: The release of these minutes provides transparency into the decisions shaping the careers of India's promising young badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has published the minutes from the recent Junior Selection Committee meeting held on October 19, 2026, outlining key decisions for upcoming junior events and player selections.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: This new committee ensures that Indian badminton players will have a direct and official channel to voice their concerns and contribute to policy-making within the BAI.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee on October 2, 2026, aimed at empowering players and providing them with a formal platform for representation.

title: India's Junior Squad Prepares for World Championships in Guwahati Camp
indian_angle: This national coaching camp is a critical step in preparing India's top junior badminton players to compete and achieve success at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is currently underway at the National Centre of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, bringing together India's most promising young talents for intensive training.

title: BAI Conducts Advanced Level 1 Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This advanced coaching course is instrumental in elevating the standard of badminton coaching across India, directly benefiting player development from grassroots to elite levels.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course in NCE Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, enhancing the skills of Indian badminton coaches.
